about: Northwind workload for tools/sample_db_bench.py. origin 'upstream-view': the 16 CREATE VIEW bodies of upstream/instnwnd.sql (name = upstream view name), adapted to BigQuery SQL as 'adaptation' says; 'upstream-procedure': the SELECT of an upstream stored procedure with its parameters bound to the values in 'adaptation'; 'authored': written for this eval. Views are also created in DuckDB (create_view) because later views read them, as upstream does.

queries.name: Customer and Suppliers by City
queries.adaptation: UNION -> UNION DISTINCT (BigQuery needs the keyword); the commented-out ORDER BY stays out
queries.sql:
SELECT City, CompanyName, ContactName, 'Customers' AS Relationship
FROM Customers
UNION DISTINCT SELECT City, CompanyName, ContactName, 'Suppliers'
FROM Suppliers

queries.name: Alphabetical list of products
queries.adaptation: none (Discontinued is INT64 holding 0 or 1, see the adapted DDL)
queries.sql:
SELECT Products.*, Categories.CategoryName
FROM Categories INNER JOIN Products ON Categories.CategoryID = Products.CategoryID
WHERE (((Products.Discontinued)=0))

queries.name: Current Product List
queries.adaptation: none; the commented-out ORDER BY stays out
queries.sql:
SELECT Product_List.ProductID, Product_List.ProductName
FROM Products AS Product_List
WHERE (((Product_List.Discontinued)=0))

queries.name: Orders Qry
queries.adaptation: none
queries.sql:
SELECT Orders.OrderID, Orders.CustomerID, Orders.EmployeeID, Orders.OrderDate, Orders.RequiredDate, 
	Orders.ShippedDate, Orders.ShipVia, Orders.Freight, Orders.ShipName, Orders.ShipAddress, Orders.ShipCity, 
	Orders.ShipRegion, Orders.ShipPostalCode, Orders.ShipCountry, 
	Customers.CompanyName, Customers.Address, Customers.City, Customers.Region, Customers.PostalCode, Customers.Country
FROM Customers INNER JOIN Orders ON Customers.CustomerID = Orders.CustomerID

queries.name: Products Above Average Price
queries.adaptation: none; the commented-out ORDER BY stays out
queries.sql:
SELECT Products.ProductName, Products.UnitPrice
FROM Products
WHERE Products.UnitPrice>(SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) From Products)

queries.name: Products by Category
queries.adaptation: none; the commented-out ORDER BY stays out
queries.sql:
SELECT Categories.CategoryName, Products.ProductName, Products.QuantityPerUnit, Products.UnitsInStock, Products.Discontinued
FROM Categories INNER JOIN Products ON Categories.CategoryID = Products.CategoryID
WHERE Products.Discontinued <> 1

queries.name: Quarterly Orders
queries.adaptation: '19970101' and '19971231' (strings SQL Server converts to datetime) -> DATETIME literals
queries.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT Customers.CustomerID, Customers.CompanyName, Customers.City, Customers.Country
FROM Customers RIGHT JOIN Orders ON Customers.CustomerID = Orders.CustomerID
WHERE Orders.OrderDate BETWEEN DATETIME '1997-01-01' AND DATETIME '1997-12-31'

queries.name: Invoices
queries.adaptation: (FirstName + ' ' + LastName) -> CONCAT(FirstName, ' ', LastName) (both NULL when an operand is NULL); CONVERT(money, x) -> ROUND(x, 4) (money keeps four decimal places); "Order Details" -> `Order Details`
queries.sql:
SELECT Orders.ShipName, Orders.ShipAddress, Orders.ShipCity, Orders.ShipRegion, Orders.ShipPostalCode, 
	Orders.ShipCountry, Orders.CustomerID, Customers.CompanyName AS CustomerName, Customers.Address, Customers.City, 
	Customers.Region, Customers.PostalCode, Customers.Country, 
	CONCAT(FirstName, ' ', LastName) AS Salesperson, 
	Orders.OrderID, Orders.OrderDate, Orders.RequiredDate, Orders.ShippedDate, Shippers.CompanyName As ShipperName, 
	`Order Details`.ProductID, Products.ProductName, `Order Details`.UnitPrice, `Order Details`.Quantity, 
	`Order Details`.Discount, 
	(ROUND((`Order Details`.UnitPrice*Quantity*(1-Discount)/100), 4)*100) AS ExtendedPrice, Orders.Freight
FROM 	Shippers INNER JOIN 
		(Products INNER JOIN 
			(
				(Employees INNER JOIN 
					(Customers INNER JOIN Orders ON Customers.CustomerID = Orders.CustomerID) 
				ON Employees.EmployeeID = Orders.EmployeeID) 
			INNER JOIN `Order Details` ON Orders.OrderID = `Order Details`.OrderID) 
		ON Products.ProductID = `Order Details`.ProductID) 
	ON Shippers.ShipperID = Orders.ShipVia

queries.name: Order Details Extended
queries.adaptation: CONVERT(money, x) -> ROUND(x, 4); "Order Details" -> `Order Details`; the commented-out ORDER BY stays out
queries.sql:
SELECT `Order Details`.OrderID, `Order Details`.ProductID, Products.ProductName, 
	`Order Details`.UnitPrice, `Order Details`.Quantity, `Order Details`.Discount, 
	(ROUND((`Order Details`.UnitPrice*Quantity*(1-Discount)/100), 4)*100) AS ExtendedPrice
FROM Products INNER JOIN `Order Details` ON Products.ProductID = `Order Details`.ProductID

queries.name: Order Subtotals
queries.adaptation: CONVERT(money, x) -> ROUND(x, 4); "Order Details" -> `Order Details`
queries.sql:
SELECT `Order Details`.OrderID, Sum(ROUND((`Order Details`.UnitPrice*Quantity*(1-Discount)/100), 4)*100) AS Subtotal
FROM `Order Details`
GROUP BY `Order Details`.OrderID

queries.name: Product Sales for 1997
queries.adaptation: CONVERT(money, x) -> ROUND(x, 4); '19970101'/'19971231' -> DATETIME literals; "Order Details" -> `Order Details`
queries.sql:
SELECT Categories.CategoryName, Products.ProductName, 
Sum(ROUND((`Order Details`.UnitPrice*Quantity*(1-Discount)/100), 4)*100) AS ProductSales
FROM (Categories INNER JOIN Products ON Categories.CategoryID = Products.CategoryID) 
	INNER JOIN (Orders 
		INNER JOIN `Order Details` ON Orders.OrderID = `Order Details`.OrderID) 
	ON Products.ProductID = `Order Details`.ProductID
WHERE (((Orders.ShippedDate) Between DATETIME '1997-01-01' And DATETIME '1997-12-31'))
GROUP BY Categories.CategoryName, Products.ProductName

queries.name: Category Sales for 1997
queries.adaptation: "Product Sales for 1997" -> `Product Sales for 1997` (reads that view)
queries.sql:
SELECT `Product Sales for 1997`.CategoryName, Sum(`Product Sales for 1997`.ProductSales) AS CategorySales
FROM `Product Sales for 1997`
GROUP BY `Product Sales for 1997`.CategoryName

queries.name: Sales by Category
queries.adaptation: '19970101'/'19971231' -> DATETIME literals; "Order Details Extended" -> `Order Details Extended` (reads that view); the commented-out ORDER BY stays out
queries.sql:
SELECT Categories.CategoryID, Categories.CategoryName, Products.ProductName, 
	Sum(`Order Details Extended`.ExtendedPrice) AS ProductSales
FROM 	Categories INNER JOIN 
		(Products INNER JOIN 
			(Orders INNER JOIN `Order Details Extended` ON Orders.OrderID = `Order Details Extended`.OrderID) 
		ON Products.ProductID = `Order Details Extended`.ProductID) 
	ON Categories.CategoryID = Products.CategoryID
WHERE Orders.OrderDate BETWEEN DATETIME '1997-01-01' And DATETIME '1997-12-31'
GROUP BY Categories.CategoryID, Categories.CategoryName, Products.ProductName

queries.name: Sales Totals by Amount
queries.adaptation: '19970101'/'19971231' -> DATETIME literals; "Order Subtotals" -> `Order Subtotals` (reads that view)
queries.sql:
SELECT `Order Subtotals`.Subtotal AS SaleAmount, Orders.OrderID, Customers.CompanyName, Orders.ShippedDate
FROM 	Customers INNER JOIN 
		(Orders INNER JOIN `Order Subtotals` ON Orders.OrderID = `Order Subtotals`.OrderID) 
	ON Customers.CustomerID = Orders.CustomerID
WHERE (`Order Subtotals`.Subtotal >2500) AND (Orders.ShippedDate BETWEEN DATETIME '1997-01-01' And DATETIME '1997-12-31')

queries.name: Summary of Sales by Quarter
queries.adaptation: "Order Subtotals" -> `Order Subtotals`; the commented-out ORDER BY stays out
queries.sql:
SELECT Orders.ShippedDate, Orders.OrderID, `Order Subtotals`.Subtotal
FROM Orders INNER JOIN `Order Subtotals` ON Orders.OrderID = `Order Subtotals`.OrderID
WHERE Orders.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL

queries.name: Summary of Sales by Year
queries.adaptation: "Order Subtotals" -> `Order Subtotals`; the commented-out ORDER BY stays out (upstream's body is the same as Summary of Sales by Quarter)
queries.sql:
SELECT Orders.ShippedDate, Orders.OrderID, `Order Subtotals`.Subtotal
FROM Orders INNER JOIN `Order Subtotals` ON Orders.OrderID = `Order Subtotals`.OrderID
WHERE Orders.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL

queries.name: Ten Most Expensive Products
queries.adaptation: SET ROWCOUNT 10 -> LIMIT 10
queries.sql:
SELECT Products.ProductName AS TenMostExpensiveProducts, Products.UnitPrice
FROM Products
ORDER BY Products.UnitPrice DESC
LIMIT 10

queries.name: Employee Sales by Country
queries.adaptation: @Beginning_Date = 1997-01-01, @Ending_Date = 1997-12-31, as DATETIME literals; "Order Subtotals" -> `Order Subtotals`
queries.sql:
SELECT Employees.Country, Employees.LastName, Employees.FirstName, Orders.ShippedDate, Orders.OrderID, `Order Subtotals`.Subtotal AS SaleAmount
FROM Employees INNER JOIN 
	(Orders INNER JOIN `Order Subtotals` ON Orders.OrderID = `Order Subtotals`.OrderID) 
	ON Employees.EmployeeID = Orders.EmployeeID
WHERE Orders.ShippedDate Between DATETIME '1997-01-01' And DATETIME '1997-12-31'

queries.name: Sales by Year
queries.adaptation: @Beginning_Date = 1997-01-01, @Ending_Date = 1997-12-31; DATENAME(yy, ShippedDate) -> FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y', ShippedDate)
queries.sql:
SELECT Orders.ShippedDate, Orders.OrderID, `Order Subtotals`.Subtotal, FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y', ShippedDate) AS Year
FROM Orders INNER JOIN `Order Subtotals` ON Orders.OrderID = `Order Subtotals`.OrderID
WHERE Orders.ShippedDate Between DATETIME '1997-01-01' And DATETIME '1997-12-31'

queries.name: CustOrdersDetail
queries.adaptation: @OrderID = 10248; alias = expr -> expr AS alias; [Order Details] -> `Order Details`; CONVERT(int, x) -> CAST(TRUNC(x) AS INT64) (CONVERT truncates); CONVERT(money, x) -> ROUND(x, 4)
queries.sql:
SELECT ProductName,
    ROUND(Od.UnitPrice, 2) AS UnitPrice,
    Quantity,
    CAST(TRUNC(Discount * 100) AS INT64) AS Discount, 
    ROUND(ROUND(Quantity * (1 - Discount) * Od.UnitPrice, 4), 2) AS ExtendedPrice
FROM Products P, `Order Details` Od
WHERE Od.ProductID = P.ProductID and Od.OrderID = 10248

queries.name: CustOrdersOrders
queries.adaptation: @CustomerID = 'ALFKI'
queries.sql:
SELECT OrderID, 
	OrderDate,
	RequiredDate,
	ShippedDate
FROM Orders
WHERE CustomerID = 'ALFKI'
ORDER BY OrderID

queries.name: CustOrderHist
queries.adaptation: @CustomerID = 'ALFKI'; Total=SUM(Quantity) -> SUM(Quantity) AS Total; [Order Details] -> `Order Details`
queries.sql:
SELECT ProductName, SUM(Quantity) AS Total
FROM Products P, `Order Details` OD, Orders O, Customers C
WHERE C.CustomerID = 'ALFKI'
AND C.CustomerID = O.CustomerID AND O.OrderID = OD.OrderID AND OD.ProductID = P.ProductID
GROUP BY ProductName

queries.name: SalesByCategory
queries.adaptation: @CategoryName = 'Beverages', @OrdYear = '1998' (the IF that resets an unknown year is dropped); TotalPurchase=expr -> expr AS TotalPurchase; CONVERT(decimal(14,2), x) -> ROUND(x, 2); SUBSTRING(CONVERT(nvarchar(22), d, 111), 1, 4) -> SUBSTR(FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y/%m/%d', d), 1, 4) (style 111 is yyyy/mm/dd)
queries.sql:
SELECT ProductName,
	ROUND(SUM(ROUND(OD.Quantity * (1-OD.Discount) * OD.UnitPrice, 2)), 0) AS TotalPurchase
FROM `Order Details` OD, Orders O, Products P, Categories C
WHERE OD.OrderID = O.OrderID 
	AND OD.ProductID = P.ProductID 
	AND P.CategoryID = C.CategoryID
	AND C.CategoryName = 'Beverages'
	AND SUBSTR(FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y/%m/%d', O.OrderDate), 1, 4) = '1998'
GROUP BY ProductName
ORDER BY ProductName

SELECT o.OrderID, c.CompanyName, CONCAT(e.FirstName, ' ', e.LastName) AS employee
FROM Orders AS o
JOIN Customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
JOIN Employees AS e ON e.EmployeeID = o.EmployeeID
WHERE o.ShipCountry = 'Germany'

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE o.OrderID IS NULL

SELECT e.EmployeeID, e.LastName, m.LastName AS manager, e.Region
FROM Employees AS e
LEFT JOIN Employees AS m ON m.EmployeeID = e.ReportsTo

SELECT s.CompanyName, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.OrderDate) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(o.Freight) AS freight
FROM Orders AS o
JOIN Shippers AS s ON s.ShipperID = o.ShipVia
GROUP BY s.CompanyName, order_year

SELECT od.ProductID, SUM(od.Quantity) AS units
FROM `Order Details` AS od
GROUP BY od.ProductID
HAVING SUM(od.Quantity) > 1000

SELECT DISTINCT s.Country
FROM Suppliers AS s
JOIN Products AS p ON p.SupplierID = s.SupplierID
WHERE p.Discontinued = 1

SELECT DISTINCT ProductID, ProductName, UnitPrice
FROM Products
WHERE CategoryID = 2

SELECT ProductName
FROM Products
WHERE ProductID IN (SELECT ProductID FROM `Order Details` WHERE Discount >= 0.2)

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM Customers AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Orders AS o
  JOIN `Order Details` AS od ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID
  JOIN Products AS p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID
  WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND p.CategoryID = 8
)

SELECT CustomerID
FROM Customers
WHERE Region NOT IN (SELECT Region FROM Suppliers)

SELECT p.ProductName, p.UnitPrice
FROM Products AS p
WHERE p.UnitPrice > (SELECT AVG(p2.UnitPrice) FROM Products AS p2 WHERE p2.CategoryID = p.CategoryID)

SELECT CompanyName, Phone, 'customer' AS kind FROM Customers
UNION ALL
SELECT CompanyName, Phone, 'supplier' FROM Suppliers
UNION ALL
SELECT CompanyName, Phone, 'shipper' FROM Shippers

SELECT Country FROM Customers
EXCEPT DISTINCT
SELECT Country FROM Suppliers

SELECT City FROM Customers
INTERSECT DISTINCT
SELECT City FROM Employees

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT od.OrderID, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity) AS gross
  FROM `Order Details` AS od
  GROUP BY od.OrderID
)
SELECT o.CustomerID, o.OrderID, t.gross,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.CustomerID ORDER BY t.gross DESC) AS rnk
FROM Orders AS o
JOIN totals AS t ON t.OrderID = o.OrderID

SELECT EmployeeID, OrderID, OrderDate,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EmployeeID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS nth
FROM Orders

SELECT OrderID, ShippedDate, LEAD(ShippedDate) OVER (ORDER BY OrderID) AS next_shipped
FROM Orders
WHERE EmployeeID = 9

SELECT COALESCE(r.RegionID, t.RegionID) AS RegionID, r.RegionDescription, t.territories
FROM Region AS r
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS territories FROM Territories GROUP BY RegionID) AS t
  ON t.RegionID = r.RegionID

SELECT c.CustomerID, d.CustomerTypeID
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN CustomerCustomerDemo AS d ON d.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Country = 'Mexico'

SELECT o.OrderID, DATETIME_DIFF(o.ShippedDate, o.RequiredDate, DAY) AS days_late
FROM Orders AS o
WHERE o.ShippedDate > o.RequiredDate

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT OrderID, UnitPrice * Quantity AS gross FROM `Order Details`
),
per_order AS (
  SELECT OrderID, SUM(gross) AS gross FROM lines GROUP BY OrderID
),
unused AS (
  SELECT CategoryID FROM Categories
)
SELECT o.ShipCountry, SUM(p.gross) AS gross
FROM Orders AS o
JOIN per_order AS p ON p.OrderID = o.OrderID
WHERE TRUE
GROUP BY o.ShipCountry

SELECT e.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT r.RegionID) AS regions
FROM Employees AS e
JOIN EmployeeTerritories AS et ON et.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID
JOIN Territories AS t ON t.TerritoryID = et.TerritoryID
JOIN Region AS r ON r.RegionID = t.RegionID
GROUP BY e.LastName

SELECT ShipCountry, COUNTIF(ShippedDate IS NULL) AS unshipped, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM Orders
GROUP BY ShipCountry

SELECT p.ProductName, od.OrderID
FROM `Order Details` AS od
RIGHT JOIN Products AS p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID AND od.Quantity >= 100
